pairs.subject: table
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/List.tsx:106 The event list has role=grid, but focus stays on the scroll container: there is no aria-activedescendant and no cell ever takes focus, so a screen-reader user in application mode does not hear the selected row that J/K or ↑/↓ moves to.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/List.tsx:106 Grid role with one tab stop (tabIndex 0 on the scroller), but arrows only change aria-selected on rows. There is no cell focus, no activedescendant, no left/right traversal, and the column headers sit outside the grid element. This is the 'cells cannot take focus' anti-pattern.
app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/read.ts:91 Keyset on the (t, seq) cursor with PAGE=500. Older pages are appended through a Server Action with the page's own cursor, never an offset.

app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/List.tsx:89 The order itself is total: the kernel sorts `t, seq` (events-query.ts:158) and the merge uses the same comparator. The gap is accessibility: the order is exposed only in the button's label, with no aria-sort on a columnheader. Toggling remounts the Ledger (key includes the order), so no status message speaks the change.

app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/Toolbar.tsx:57 Entered text (draft) and the applied filter (the URL) are separate. Free text commits on submit, facets on change. page.tsx keys the client by filter identity, so rows and selection from an old filter do not survive.

app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/read.ts:16 Filter, sort and window all run on the server. The unindexed text part is scanned server-side and labelled ('searched N', 'N+'). Client-side cost over loaded rows is marked '+'.
app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/List.tsx:58 Bounded pages, fixed row height read from the tokens, windowed rendering, rows keyed by seq.

app/(studio)/ledger/page.tsx:32 Empty states are typed by cause (List.tsx:116-121: nothing recorded yet vs 0 events + clear filters). But a failed read replaces the whole surface, chrome included, with an ErrorLine that offers no retry.
app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/read.ts:34 Rows reach the client 500 at a time on an explicit 'older' press, so the browser's scroll-size ceiling is not in reach.
app/(studio)/ledger/page.tsx:1 Read-only, append-only list. No cell editing, paste or fill.
app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/List.tsx:85 The only copy is whole rows as JSON Lines. No cell-range copy and no paste back.
app/(studio)/ledger/_ledger/List.tsx:81 The export is JSONL for agents, not CSV for spreadsheets.
